proposal.title: Debug information exposed in responses
proposal.description: The synthetic captured response contains an internal service name and a stack trace.
limitations: Only the supplied fixture request was captured; production exposure and access controls were not assessed.
preconditions: An authenticated caller can reach the diagnostic endpoint.

examples.impact: Internal names and stack frames could help an attacker map the application.
examples.assessmentReason: The captured sample contains the claimed fields. This is not a human confirmation.

proposal.title: Order lookup may skip object authorization
proposal.description: The order handler reads a record by the supplied order ID. No owner comparison appears in this handler.
limitations: Middleware and database row policies were not verified. No live request was made.
preconditions: The route is reachable by an authenticated customer; no upstream policy enforces ownership.

examples.impact: If access is not checked elsewhere, an authenticated customer could read another customer’s order.
examples.assessmentReason: Static evidence only. The check did not execute a request.

files.name: order-handler

proposal.title: Order export endpoint shares records across projects
proposal.description: The synthetic review fixture records an export containing a row owned by another project.
limitations: The fixture covers one export path and two demonstration projects. It does not establish the scope of other endpoints.
preconditions: The caller can create an export; a second project owns an exported row.

examples.impact: A caller could obtain another project’s order data through an export.
examples.assessmentReason: The retained synthetic export includes a row with a different project identifier.

analyst.name: Demo analyst
analyst.reason: Compared the two synthetic project fixtures and confirmed the cross-project export. This is a predefined demo decision.

proposal.title: Product search builds SQL from request text without a parameter placeholder
proposal.description: The search route concatenates the supplied query into an SQL string, then passes that string to the database wrapper.
limitations: No payload was executed. The database wrapper and upstream input validation need review.
preconditions: The query text reaches this code path without a separate escaping or parameterization step.

examples.impact: If input reaches the SQL parser unchanged, a caller could alter the intended query.
examples.assessmentReason: Two authored source locations are available; no dynamic check was performed.

files.name: search-route
files.text:
const sql = "SELECT id FROM products WHERE name = '" + req.query.q + "'";
const rows = await db.query(sql);

sources.text:
const sql = "SELECT id FROM products WHERE name = '" + req.query.q + "'";
const rows = await db.query(sql);

proposal.title: Container image may inherit a privileged user
proposal.description: The supplied Dockerfile excerpt has no explicit USER instruction. The inherited base-image user is unknown.
limitations: The base image and deployed container security context were unavailable. Running as root has not been established.
preconditions: The base image runs as UID 0 and the runtime does not override that user.

examples.impact: A process running with unnecessary privileges could increase the impact of a separate compromise.
examples.assessmentReason: The deployed image and runtime identity were unavailable for verification.

proposal.title: Login throttling requirement has no supporting evidence
proposal.description: The supplied baseline asks for protection against repeated login attempts. This review has no endpoint or retained evidence showing whether the requirement is met.
limitations: Missing evidence does not prove that throttling is absent. The affected endpoint has not been identified.
preconditions: Identify the authentication endpoint and the configured throttling policy before testing.

examples.impact: If throttling is absent, repeated credential attempts may remain possible. This condition has not been demonstrated.
examples.assessmentReason: No verification was performed and no captured evidence is available.
